drift.text:
These boards are presentation copies of the six Mermaid diagrams in run-dmcp/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.

The Markdown is the source of truth and is what CI sees. These pictures are regenerated from it, never edited by hand, and they WILL drift:

• Level 3 boards go stale first — a new register module, a new timeline file, a moved route.
• Level 2 drifts when a container or a protocol changes.
• Level 1 drifts only when a new kind of consumer or surface appears.

Each board's footer states the version it was drawn from and its expected drift. When a board disagrees with the Markdown, the Markdown wins.
